TC-22/S20.title: Task toggles named with their task and exposing done / not done; axe on the task screens (accessibility: our own addition)
TC-22/S20.detail: Visual lane (qa-agent-tests/visual/encounter.spec.ts, run on 43c38a4f with its own output folder), desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15; no model involved (the lane blocks every action). Same as e02167f (the task list files changed only in billing props): 2/12 per profile. Hospital Post-Round: 'Complete task: …' / 'Reopen task: …' with aria-pressed matching the stored state (pass). Nursing Home Post-Round: the toggles have no name and no state; both Task Export screens: 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' without the task text and without aria-pressed; axe: color-contrast (serious) on every screen, button-name (critical, 5×) on the Nursing Home Post-Round. Accessibility is asked by no UAT item or ticket, so this is recorded as suggestion A1 (known), not judged. T2 (visit label, TFA-92585 ready for pr) is todo.
